law_name: Law on Copyright of the DPRK (Decree No. 2141 of 2001, amended up to Decree No. 1532 of 2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years; institutional works up to 50 years from publication
fair_use_exceptions: State management documents and current news excluded from protection (Art. 12), unless commercial purpose pursued (2006 amendment)
notes: Berne member since 28 April 2003. A 2012 version is claimed on a wiki talk page but unverified.
